signal: Openforce launched its AI-built Master Toolkit and a new AI-based Vendor Portal in 2025, and hired Carly Fliesher as SVP of Enterprise Sales for last-mile/ecommerce.

email.body1:
Bill, saw Openforce ship the AI-built Master Toolkit and new Vendor Portal, plus an SVP hire for enterprise last-mile.

Leaning into enterprise that hard usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Openforce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bill, quick follow-up for Openforce.

Moving upmarket into enterprise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Openforce needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bill, last bit of proof for Openforce.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Openforce's reply rate likely compares to other workforce-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bill, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. An upmarket push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Openforce either way.
